summary: Flat kerb on a quiet residential street, with homes 11-13 m away.

best_section.where: West side of Almeida Street, about a third of the way up from the bend

drivers.seclusion: Houses line both sides, dwellings 11-13 m from the kerb; no bush or open ground.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with kerbside room; a few cars parked along it.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street; a motorway runs parallel about 80 m west.
drivers.convention: Residents park on the street, so a van would not stand out much.

flags: Steeper near the start: up to 13.8% max in places
sun_shade: Mostly open to sun; some garden trees shade patches from the west.
